claims.text: HTN: thiazide-type diuretics are the most used diuretics;
claims.quote: Thiazide-type diuretics (thiazide diuretics and thiazide-like diuretics) are most commonly used.

claims.text: chlorthalidone and indapamide (thiazide-like) are preferred over HCTZ for higher potency and longer action;
claims.quote: Chlorthalidone and indapamide, thiazide-like diuretics, are preferred over hydrochlorothiazide because of their higher potency (1) and longer duration of action.

claims.text: thiazides boost ACE-I/ARB effect more than other classes do.
claims.quote: Thiazide-type diuretics enhance the antihypertensive activity of ACE inhibitors and angiotensin II receptor blockers more than that of other classes of antihypertensives

claims.text: HCTZ (HTN): start one capsule once daily
claims.quote: The adult initial dose of hydrochlorothiazide capsules, USP is one capsule given once daily
claims.locator: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION (For Control of Hypertension)

claims.quote: Hydrochlorothiazide capsules, USP are supplied as 12.5 mg capsules for oral use.
Total daily doses greater than 50 mg are not recommended.
claims.locator: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION (For Control of Hypertension)

claims.quote: Hydrochlorothiazide is contraindicated in patients with anuria. Hypersensitivity to this product or other sulfonamide derived drugs is also contraindicated.

claims.text: Can cause acute myopia and angle-closure glaucoma (eye pain or decreased vision within hours–weeks):
claims.quote: Symptoms include acute onset of decreased visual acuity or ocular pain and typically occur within hours to weeks of drug initiation.
claims.locator: Acute Myopia and Secondary Angle-Closure Glaucoma

claims.quote: The primary treatment is to discontinue hydrochlorothiazide as rapidly as possible.
claims.locator: Acute Myopia and Secondary Angle-Closure Glaucoma

claims.quote: Corticosteroid, ACTH: intensified electrolyte depletion, particularly hypokalemia.

claims.text: low K or Mg sensitizes the heart to digitalis toxicity;
claims.quote: Hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia can provoke ventricular arrhythmias or sensitize or exaggerate the response of the heart to the toxic effects of digitalis.

claims.text: cholestyramine/colestipol bind HCTZ and cut its absorption.
claims.quote: Cholestyramine and colestipol resins bind the hydrochlorothiazide and reduce its absorption from the gastrointestinal tract

claims.text: Counsel: protect skin from the sun and get regular skin-cancer screening (non-melanoma skin cancer risk).
claims.quote: Instruct patients taking hydrochlorothiazide to protect skin from the sun and undergo regular skin cancer screening.

claims.text: Interactions (all diuretics): lithium—avoid, diuretics cut its clearance and risk toxicity;
claims.quote: Lithium generally should not be given with diuretics because they reduce lithium’s renal clearance and add a high risk of lithium toxicity.

claims.text: NSAIDs can blunt the diuretic and antihypertensive effect of loop, K-sparing and thiazide diuretics.
claims.quote: the administration of a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory agent can reduce the diuretic, natriuretic, and antihypertensive effects of loop, potassium-sparing and thiazide diuretics
